title: EmployeeFile
description: Schema for a single hot-loadable authoritative employee file under ./employees/<employee_id>.json. Loaded by STEP 0 resolveEmployee as the highest-priority resolution source. The role_id field is pre-canonicalization; STEP 0 canonicalizes it against the Role_Catalog and writes the final employee.role object.

employee_id.description: Stable identifier; MUST match the file basename (excluding .json).

role_id.description: Pre-canonicalization role string. STEP 0 matches it against Role_Catalog role_id + aliases to produce the canonical employee.role.role_id.

industry.description: Industry the employee works in. Used by STEP 1.2 metric curation.

job_responsibilities.description: Free-text description of what this employee actually does day-to-day. Primary semantic signal for STEP 1.2 add/remove decisions.

scenarios.description: Scenario tags this employee handles. Drives STEP 2 enrichTestCases scenario matching.

level.description: Optional seniority level (employee / supervisor / manager / ...). Copied into employee.role.level.

sop_documents.description: Optional SOP references consumed by STEP 1.5 when synthesizing test cases.
